# Country scope everywhere unless said. State of the works of the wonder in province P (all on the country):
#   flags      DA_WW_building_P, DA_WW_rushed_P, DA_WW_any_works
#   variables  DA_WW_cost_P / DA_WW_months_P   price and months of the next level-up, after modifiers
#              DA_WW_cg_P, _cl_P, _tg_P, _tl_P the four modifiers in percent (country / hold, cost / time)
#              DA_WW_paid_P, _total_P, _left_P the running works; _pct_P for the bar; _fy_P, _fm_P the end date
#              DA_WW_dy_P, _dm_P / _ly_P, _lm_P  years and months of the duration / of what is left
#              DA_WW_rush_P, _refund_P         ducats of the rush and of the refund

			else_if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4039 value = 3750 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4039 value = 60 } }
			else = { set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4039 value = 1600 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4039 value = 24 } }

			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4039 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_cost }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4039 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_time who = owner }

			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4039 which = DA_WW_cf_4039 }

			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4039 value = 372 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4039 value = 372 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4039 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4039 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4039 value = 100 }

	subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4039 which = DA_WW_left_4039 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4039 value = 100 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4039 value = 1 } } divide_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4039 which = DA_WW_total_4039 } }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4039 value = trigger_value:is_year }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4039 value = trigger_value:is_month }
	change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4039 which = DA_WW_left_4039 }

DA_WW_begin_4039 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_begin_4039_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4039 which = DA_WW_cost_4039 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_cost_4039 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4039 which = DA_WW_months_4039 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4039 which = DA_WW_months_4039 }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4039
		clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4039
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_any_works
		DA_WW_progress_4039 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_rush_now_4039 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_rush_now_4039_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_rush_4039 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4039 value = 0.75 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4039 value = 0.001 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4039 value = 1000 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4039 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4039 value = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4039
		DA_WW_progress_4039 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_cancel_now_4039 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_cancel_now_4039_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_refund_4039 }
		DA_WW_give_t = yes
		if = { limit = { 4039 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 2 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 20 } }
		else_if = { limit = { 4039 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } }
		else = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 2 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 2 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 2 } }
		DA_WW_clear_4039 = yes
		DA_WW_refresh_4039 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_clear_4039 = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4039
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4039
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4039 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4039 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4039 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4039 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4039 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4039 value = 0 }
}
DA_WW_finish_4039 = {
	if = {
		limit = { 4039 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 2 } } }
		4039 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.14 days = 3650 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 4039 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } } }
		4039 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.1 }
	}
	else = {
		4039 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.11 days = 365 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.12 days = 1095 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.1 }
	}
	DA_WW_clear_4039 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4039 = yes
}
DA_WW_tick_4039 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4039 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owns = 4039 } }
			DA_WW_clear_4039 = yes    # the hold was lost, and the works with it
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_halted_4039 = yes } }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4039 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4039 value = 1 } } }
				DA_WW_finish_4039 = yes
			}
			else = { DA_WW_progress_4039 = yes }
		}
		else = { DA_WW_progress_4039 = yes }
	}
}

				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4217 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4217 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4217 which = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}
DA_WW_progress_4217 = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4217 which = DA_WW_total_4217 }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4217 which = DA_WW_left_4217 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4217 value = 100 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4217 value = 1 } } divide_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4217 which = DA_WW_total_4217 } }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4217 value = trigger_value:is_year }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 value = trigger_value:is_month }
	change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 which = DA_WW_left_4217 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4217 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4217 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4217 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4217 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4217 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4217 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4217 which = DA_WW_left_4217 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4217 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4217 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4217 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4217 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4217 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4217 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4217 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4217 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4217 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4217 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4217 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4217 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4217 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4217 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4217 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4217 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4217 which = DA_WW_paid_4217 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4217 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4217 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4217 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4217 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4217 value = 10 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4217 which = DA_WW_paid_4217 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4217 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4217 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4217 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4217 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4217 value = 10 }
}
DA_WW_begin_4217 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_begin_4217_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4217 which = DA_WW_cost_4217 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_cost_4217 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4217 which = DA_WW_months_4217 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4217 which = DA_WW_months_4217 }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4217
		clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4217
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_any_works
		DA_WW_progress_4217 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_rush_now_4217 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_rush_now_4217_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_rush_4217 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4217 value = 0.75 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4217 value = 0.001 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4217 value = 1000 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4217 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4217 value = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4217
		DA_WW_progress_4217 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_cancel_now_4217 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_cancel_now_4217_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_refund_4217 }
		DA_WW_give_t = yes
		if = { limit = { 4217 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Titanium_Vault tier = 2 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 20 } }
		else_if = { limit = { 4217 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Titanium_Vault tier = 1 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } }
		else = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 2 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 2 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 2 } }
		DA_WW_clear_4217 = yes
		DA_WW_refresh_4217 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_clear_4217 = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4217
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4217
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4217 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4217 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4217 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4217 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4217 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4217 value = 0 }
}
DA_WW_finish_4217 = {
	if = {
		limit = { 4217 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Titanium_Vault tier = 2 } } }
		4217 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Titanium_Vault tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Hold_Gor_Vazumbrog.14 days = 3650 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 4217 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Titanium_Vault tier = 1 } } }
		4217 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Titanium_Vault tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.2 }
	}
	else = {
		4217 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Titanium_Vault tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Hold_Gor_Vazumbrog.11 days = 365 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Hold_Gor_Vazumbrog.12 days = 1095 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.2 }
	}
	DA_WW_clear_4217 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4217 = yes
}
DA_WW_tick_4217 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4217 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owns = 4217 } }
			DA_WW_clear_4217 = yes    # the hold was lost, and the works with it
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_halted_4217 = yes } }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4217 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4217 value = 1 } } }
				DA_WW_finish_4217 = yes
			}
			else = { DA_WW_progress_4217 = yes }
		}
		else = { DA_WW_progress_4217 = yes }
	}
}

# ---------------- Argrâstun Cathedral (Ovdal-az-Ân, 4284) ----------------
DA_WW_refresh_4284 = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 4284 4284 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Argrastun_Cathedral tier = 0 } } }
		4284 = {
			if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Argrastun_Cathedral tier = 2 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4284 value = 7500 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4284 value = 120 } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Argrastun_Cathedral tier = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4284 value = 3750 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4284 value = 60 } }
			else = { set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4284 value = 1600 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4284 value = 24 } }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4284 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_cost who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4284 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_cost }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4284 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_time who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4284 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_time }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4284 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4284 which = DA_WW_cg_4284 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4284 which = DA_WW_cl_4284 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4284 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4284 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4284 which = DA_WW_cf_4284 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4284 value = 0.1 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4284 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4284 value = 1000 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4284 value = 10 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4284 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4284 which = DA_WW_tg_4284 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4284 which = DA_WW_tl_4284 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4284 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4284 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4284 which = DA_WW_tf_4284 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4284 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4284 value = 1000 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4284 value = 10 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4284 value = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4284 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4284 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4284 value = 372 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4284 value = 372 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4284 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4284 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4284 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4284 value = 100 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 which = DA_WW_months_4284 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4284 value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4284 value = 16 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4284 value = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4284 value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4284 value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4284 value = 1 } }
			owner = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4284 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4284 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4284 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4284 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4284 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4284 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4284 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4284 which = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}

			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4119 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_cost }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4119 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_time who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4119 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_time }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4119 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4119 which = DA_WW_cg_4119 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4119 which = DA_WW_cl_4119 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4119 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4119 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4119 which = DA_WW_cf_4119 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4119 value = 0.1 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4119 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4119 value = 1000 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4119 value = 10 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4119 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4119 which = DA_WW_tg_4119 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4119 which = DA_WW_tl_4119 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4119 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4119 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4119 which = DA_WW_tf_4119 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4119 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4119 value = 1000 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4119 value = 10 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4119 value = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4119 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4119 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4119 value = 372 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4119 value = 372 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4119 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4119 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4119 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4119 value = 100 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 which = DA_WW_months_4119 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4119 value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4119 value = 16 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4119 value = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4119 value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4119 value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4119 value = 1 } }
			owner = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4119 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4119 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4119 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4119 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4119 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4119 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4119 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4119 which = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}
DA_WW_progress_4119 = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4119 which = DA_WW_total_4119 }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4119 which = DA_WW_left_4119 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4119 value = 100 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4119 value = 1 } } divide_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4119 which = DA_WW_total_4119 } }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4119 value = trigger_value:is_year }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 value = trigger_value:is_month }
	change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 which = DA_WW_left_4119 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4119 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4119 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4119 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4119 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4119 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4119 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4119 which = DA_WW_left_4119 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4119 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4119 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4119 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4119 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4119 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4119 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4119 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4119 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4119 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4119 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4119 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4119 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4119 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4119 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4119 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4119 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4119 which = DA_WW_paid_4119 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4119 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4119 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4119 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4119 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4119 value = 10 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4119 which = DA_WW_paid_4119 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4119 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4119 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4119 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4119 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4119 value = 10 }
}
DA_WW_begin_4119 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_begin_4119_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4119 which = DA_WW_cost_4119 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_cost_4119 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4119 which = DA_WW_months_4119 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4119 which = DA_WW_months_4119 }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4119
		clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4119
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_any_works
		DA_WW_progress_4119 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_rush_now_4119 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_rush_now_4119_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_rush_4119 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4119 value = 0.75 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4119 value = 0.001 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4119 value = 1000 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4119 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4119 value = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4119
		DA_WW_progress_4119 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_cancel_now_4119 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_cancel_now_4119_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_refund_4119 }
		DA_WW_give_t = yes
		if = { limit = { 4119 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Ancient_Research_facility1 tier = 2 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 20 } }
		else_if = { limit = { 4119 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Ancient_Research_facility1 tier = 1 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } }
		else = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 5 } }
		DA_WW_clear_4119 = yes
		DA_WW_refresh_4119 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_clear_4119 = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4119
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4119
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4119 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4119 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4119 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4119 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4119 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4119 value = 0 }
}
DA_WW_finish_4119 = {
	if = {
		limit = { 4119 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Ancient_Research_facility1 tier = 2 } } }
		4119 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Ancient_Research_facility1 tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 4119 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Ancient_Research_facility1 tier = 1 } } }
		4119 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Ancient_Research_facility1 tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.4 }
	}
	else = {
		4119 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Ancient_Research_facility1 tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.4 }
	}
	DA_WW_clear_4119 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4119 = yes
}
DA_WW_tick_4119 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4119 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owns = 4119 } }
			DA_WW_clear_4119 = yes    # the hold was lost, and the works with it
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_halted_4119 = yes } }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4119 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4119 value = 1 } } }
				DA_WW_finish_4119 = yes
			}
			else = { DA_WW_progress_4119 = yes }
		}
		else = { DA_WW_progress_4119 = yes }
	}
}

# ---------------- Amldavhad Training Facility (Mithradhûm, 4236) ----------------
DA_WW_refresh_4236 = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 4236 4236 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Dwarven_Workshop tier = 0 } } }
		4236 = {
			if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = The_Dwarven_Workshop tier = 2 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4236 value = 7500 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4236 value = 120 } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = The_Dwarven_Workshop tier = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4236 value = 3750 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4236 value = 60 } }
			else = { set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4236 value = 1600 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4236 value = 24 } }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4236 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_cost who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4236 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_cost }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4236 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_time who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4236 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_time }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4236 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4236 which = DA_WW_cg_4236 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4236 which = DA_WW_cl_4236 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4236 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4236 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4236 which = DA_WW_cf_4236 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4236 value = 0.1 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4236 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4236 value = 1000 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4236 value = 10 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4236 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4236 which = DA_WW_tg_4236 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4236 which = DA_WW_tl_4236 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4236 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4236 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4236 which = DA_WW_tf_4236 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4236 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4236 value = 1000 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4236 value = 10 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4236 value = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4236 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4236 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4236 value = 372 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4236 value = 372 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4236 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4236 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4236 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4236 value = 100 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 which = DA_WW_months_4236 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4236 value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4236 value = 16 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4236 value = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4236 value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4236 value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4236 value = 1 } }
			owner = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4236 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4236 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4236 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4236 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4236 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4236 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4236 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4236 which = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}

		DA_WW_give_t = yes
		if = { limit = { 4236 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Dwarven_Workshop tier = 2 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 20 } }
		else_if = { limit = { 4236 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Dwarven_Workshop tier = 1 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } }
		else = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 5 } }
		DA_WW_clear_4236 = yes
		DA_WW_refresh_4236 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_clear_4236 = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4236
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4236
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4236 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4236 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4236 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4236 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4236 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4236 value = 0 }
}
DA_WW_finish_4236 = {
	if = {
		limit = { 4236 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Dwarven_Workshop tier = 2 } } }
		4236 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = The_Dwarven_Workshop tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Mithradum_event.4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 4236 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Dwarven_Workshop tier = 1 } } }
		4236 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = The_Dwarven_Workshop tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Mithradum_event.3 }
	}
	else = {
		4236 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = The_Dwarven_Workshop tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Mithradum_event.2 }
	}
	DA_WW_clear_4236 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4236 = yes
}
DA_WW_tick_4236 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4236 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owns = 4236 } }
			DA_WW_clear_4236 = yes    # the hold was lost, and the works with it
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_halted_4236 = yes } }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4236 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4236 value = 1 } } }
				DA_WW_finish_4236 = yes
			}
			else = { DA_WW_progress_4236 = yes }
		}
		else = { DA_WW_progress_4236 = yes }
	}
}

# ---------------- The Setzunkhupa (Dûr-Vazhatun, 4020) ----------------
DA_WW_refresh_4020 = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 4020 4020 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Sky_Hold tier = 0 } } }
		4020 = {
			if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = The_Sky_Hold tier = 2 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4020 value = 7500 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4020 value = 120 } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = The_Sky_Hold tier = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4020 value = 3750 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4020 value = 60 } }
			else = { set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4020 value = 1600 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4020 value = 24 } }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4020 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_cost who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4020 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_cost }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4020 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_time who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4020 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_time }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4020 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4020 which = DA_WW_cg_4020 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4020 which = DA_WW_cl_4020 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4020 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4020 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4020 which = DA_WW_cf_4020 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4020 value = 0.1 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4020 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4020 value = 1000 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4020 value = 10 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4020 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4020 which = DA_WW_tg_4020 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4020 which = DA_WW_tl_4020 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4020 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4020 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4020 which = DA_WW_tf_4020 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4020 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4020 value = 1000 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4020 value = 10 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4020 value = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4020 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4020 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4020 value = 372 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4020 value = 372 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4020 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4020 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4020 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4020 value = 100 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 which = DA_WW_months_4020 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4020 value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4020 value = 16 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4020 value = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4020 value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4020 value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4020 value = 1 } }
			owner = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4020 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4020 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4020 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4020 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4020 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4020 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4020 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4020 which = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}
DA_WW_progress_4020 = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4020 which = DA_WW_total_4020 }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4020 which = DA_WW_left_4020 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4020 value = 100 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4020 value = 1 } } divide_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4020 which = DA_WW_total_4020 } }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4020 value = trigger_value:is_year }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 value = trigger_value:is_month }
	change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 which = DA_WW_left_4020 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4020 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4020 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4020 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4020 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4020 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4020 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4020 which = DA_WW_left_4020 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4020 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4020 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4020 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4020 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4020 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4020 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4020 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4020 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4020 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4020 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4020 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4020 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4020 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4020 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4020 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4020 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4020 which = DA_WW_paid_4020 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4020 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4020 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4020 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4020 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4020 value = 10 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4020 which = DA_WW_paid_4020 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4020 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4020 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4020 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4020 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4020 value = 10 }
}
DA_WW_begin_4020 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_begin_4020_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4020 which = DA_WW_cost_4020 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_cost_4020 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4020 which = DA_WW_months_4020 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4020 which = DA_WW_months_4020 }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4020
		clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4020
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_any_works
		DA_WW_progress_4020 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_rush_now_4020 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_rush_now_4020_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_rush_4020 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4020 value = 0.75 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4020 value = 0.001 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4020 value = 1000 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4020 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4020 value = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4020
		DA_WW_progress_4020 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_cancel_now_4020 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_cancel_now_4020_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_refund_4020 }
		DA_WW_give_t = yes
		if = { limit = { 4020 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Sky_Hold tier = 2 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 20 } }
		else_if = { limit = { 4020 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Sky_Hold tier = 1 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } }
		else = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 5 } }
		DA_WW_clear_4020 = yes
		DA_WW_refresh_4020 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_clear_4020 = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4020
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4020
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4020 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4020 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4020 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4020 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4020 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4020 value = 0 }
}
DA_WW_finish_4020 = {
	if = {
		limit = { 4020 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Sky_Hold tier = 2 } } }
		4020 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = The_Sky_Hold tier = 1 } }
		4020 = { province_event = { id = DA_Dur_Vazhatun_event.4 days = 30 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 4020 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Sky_Hold tier = 1 } } }
		4020 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = The_Sky_Hold tier = 1 } }
		4020 = { province_event = { id = DA_Dur_Vazhatun_event.3 days = 30 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.6 }
	}
	else = {
		4020 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = The_Sky_Hold tier = 1 } }
		4020 = { province_event = { id = DA_Dur_Vazhatun_event.2 days = 30 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.6 }
	}
	DA_WW_clear_4020 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4020 = yes
}
DA_WW_tick_4020 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4020 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owns = 4020 } }
			DA_WW_clear_4020 = yes    # the hold was lost, and the works with it
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_halted_4020 = yes } }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4020 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4020 value = 1 } } }
				DA_WW_finish_4020 = yes
			}
			else = { DA_WW_progress_4020 = yes }
		}
		else = { DA_WW_progress_4020 = yes }
	}
}

	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2963 which = DA_WW_left_2963 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2963 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2963 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2963 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2963 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2963 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2963 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2963 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2963 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2963 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2963 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2963 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2963 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2963 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2963 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2963 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2963 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2963 which = DA_WW_paid_2963 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2963 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2963 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2963 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2963 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2963 value = 10 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2963 which = DA_WW_paid_2963 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2963 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2963 value = 0.1 }

	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2963 value = 1000 }

DA_WW_begin_2963 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_begin_2963_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_2963 which = DA_WW_cost_2963 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_cost_2963 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_2963 which = DA_WW_months_2963 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2963 which = DA_WW_months_2963 }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_building_2963
		clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_2963
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_any_works
		DA_WW_progress_2963 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_rush_now_2963 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_rush_now_2963_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_rush_2963 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2963 value = 0.75 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2963 value = 0.001 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2963 value = 1000 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2963 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2963 value = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_2963
		DA_WW_progress_2963 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_cancel_now_2963 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_cancel_now_2963_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_refund_2963 }
		DA_WW_give_t = yes
		if = { limit = { 2963 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Dwarven_Laboratory tier = 2 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 20 } }
		else_if = { limit = { 2963 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Dwarven_Laboratory tier = 1 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } }
		else = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 5 } }
		DA_WW_clear_2963 = yes
		DA_WW_refresh_2963 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_clear_2963 = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_building_2963
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_2963
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2963 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_2963 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_2963 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_2963 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2963 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2963 value = 0 }
}
DA_WW_finish_2963 = {
	if = {
		limit = { 2963 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Dwarven_Laboratory tier = 2 } } }
		2963 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = The_Dwarven_Laboratory tier = 1 } }
		2963 = { province_event = { id = DA_Hul_Jorkad_event.4 days = 30 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 2963 = { has_great_project = { type = The_Dwarven_Laboratory tier = 1 } } }
		2963 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = The_Dwarven_Laboratory tier = 1 } }
		2963 = { province_event = { id = DA_Hul_Jorkad_event.3 days = 30 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.7 }
	}
	else = {
		2963 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = The_Dwarven_Laboratory tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Hul_Jorkad_event.2 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.7 }
	}
	DA_WW_clear_2963 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_2963 = yes
}
DA_WW_tick_2963 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_2963 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owns = 2963 } }
			DA_WW_clear_2963 = yes    # the hold was lost, and the works with it
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_halted_2963 = yes } }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2963 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2963 value = 1 } } }
				DA_WW_finish_2963 = yes
			}
			else = { DA_WW_progress_2963 = yes }
		}
		else = { DA_WW_progress_2963 = yes }
	}
}

# ---------------- Railway Control Center (Er-Natvir, 2931) ----------------
DA_WW_refresh_2931 = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 2931 2931 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Railway_HQ tier = 0 } } }
		2931 = {
			if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Railway_HQ tier = 2 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2931 value = 7500 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2931 value = 120 } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Railway_HQ tier = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2931 value = 3750 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2931 value = 60 } }
			else = { set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2931 value = 1600 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2931 value = 24 } }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_2931 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_cost who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_2931 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_cost }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_2931 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_time who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_2931 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_time }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_2931 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_2931 which = DA_WW_cg_2931 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_2931 which = DA_WW_cl_2931 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_2931 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_2931 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2931 which = DA_WW_cf_2931 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2931 value = 0.1 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2931 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2931 value = 1000 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2931 value = 10 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_2931 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_2931 which = DA_WW_tg_2931 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_2931 which = DA_WW_tl_2931 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_2931 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_2931 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2931 which = DA_WW_tf_2931 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2931 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2931 value = 1000 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2931 value = 10 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2931 value = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2931 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2931 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2931 value = 372 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2931 value = 372 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_2931 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_2931 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_2931 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_2931 value = 100 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 which = DA_WW_months_2931 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2931 value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2931 value = 16 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2931 value = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2931 value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2931 value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2931 value = 1 } }
			owner = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2931 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2931 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_2931 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_2931 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_2931 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_2931 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2931 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2931 which = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}
DA_WW_progress_2931 = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_2931 which = DA_WW_total_2931 }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_2931 which = DA_WW_left_2931 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_2931 value = 100 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_2931 value = 1 } } divide_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_2931 which = DA_WW_total_2931 } }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2931 value = trigger_value:is_year }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 value = trigger_value:is_month }
	change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 which = DA_WW_left_2931 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2931 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2931 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2931 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2931 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2931 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2931 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2931 which = DA_WW_left_2931 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2931 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2931 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2931 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2931 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2931 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2931 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2931 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2931 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2931 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2931 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2931 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2931 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2931 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2931 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2931 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2931 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2931 which = DA_WW_paid_2931 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2931 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2931 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2931 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2931 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2931 value = 10 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2931 which = DA_WW_paid_2931 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2931 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2931 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2931 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2931 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2931 value = 10 }
}

		DA_WW_give_t = yes

		else_if = { limit = { 2931 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Railway_HQ tier = 1 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } }
		else = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 5 } }
		DA_WW_clear_2931 = yes
		DA_WW_refresh_2931 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_clear_2931 = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_building_2931
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_2931
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2931 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_2931 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_2931 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_2931 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2931 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2931 value = 0 }
}
DA_WW_finish_2931 = {
	if = {
		limit = { 2931 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Railway_HQ tier = 2 } } }
		2931 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Railway_HQ tier = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_can_upgrade_rails_2
		country_event = { id = DA_Er_Natvir_event.4 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Er_Natvir_event.14 days = 1825 }
		DA_RW_recount = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 2931 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Railway_HQ tier = 1 } } }
		2931 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Railway_HQ tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Er_Natvir_event.3 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Er_Natvir_event.12 days = 1095 }
		DA_RW_recount = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.8 }
	}
	else = {
		2931 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Railway_HQ tier = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_can_upgrade_rails
		country_event = { id = DA_Er_Natvir_event.2 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Er_Natvir_event.11 days = 365 }
		DA_RW_recount = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.8 }
	}
	DA_WW_clear_2931 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_2931 = yes
}
DA_WW_tick_2931 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_2931 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owns = 2931 } }
			DA_WW_clear_2931 = yes    # the hold was lost, and the works with it
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_halted_2931 = yes } }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2931 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2931 value = 1 } } }
				DA_WW_finish_2931 = yes
			}
			else = { DA_WW_progress_2931 = yes }
		}
		else = { DA_WW_progress_2931 = yes }
	}
}

			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_2868 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_2868 which = DA_WW_tg_2868 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_2868 which = DA_WW_tl_2868 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_2868 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_2868 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2868 which = DA_WW_tf_2868 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2868 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2868 value = 1000 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2868 value = 10 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2868 value = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2868 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2868 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2868 value = 372 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2868 value = 372 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_2868 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_2868 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_2868 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_2868 value = 100 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 which = DA_WW_months_2868 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2868 value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2868 value = 16 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2868 value = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2868 value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2868 value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2868 value = 1 } }
			owner = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_2868 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_2868 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_2868 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_2868 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_2868 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_2868 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_2868 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_2868 which = PREV }

		}
	}

DA_WW_progress_2868 = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_2868 which = DA_WW_total_2868 }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_2868 which = DA_WW_left_2868 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_2868 value = 100 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_2868 value = 1 } } divide_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_2868 which = DA_WW_total_2868 } }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2868 value = trigger_value:is_year }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 value = trigger_value:is_month }
	change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 which = DA_WW_left_2868 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2868 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2868 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2868 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2868 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_2868 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_2868 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2868 which = DA_WW_left_2868 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2868 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2868 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2868 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2868 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2868 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2868 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2868 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2868 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2868 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2868 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2868 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2868 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2868 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2868 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_2868 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_2868 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2868 which = DA_WW_paid_2868 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2868 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2868 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2868 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2868 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2868 value = 10 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2868 which = DA_WW_paid_2868 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2868 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2868 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2868 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2868 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2868 value = 10 }
}
DA_WW_begin_2868 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_begin_2868_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_2868 which = DA_WW_cost_2868 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_cost_2868 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_2868 which = DA_WW_months_2868 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2868 which = DA_WW_months_2868 }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_building_2868
		clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_2868
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_any_works
		DA_WW_progress_2868 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_rush_now_2868 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_rush_now_2868_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_rush_2868 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2868 value = 0.75 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2868 value = 0.001 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2868 value = 1000 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2868 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2868 value = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_2868
		DA_WW_progress_2868 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_cancel_now_2868 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_cancel_now_2868_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_refund_2868 }
		DA_WW_give_t = yes
		if = { limit = { 2868 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Exoskeletons_Workshop tier = 2 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 20 } }
		else_if = { limit = { 2868 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Exoskeletons_Workshop tier = 1 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } }
		else = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 5 } }
		DA_WW_clear_2868 = yes
		DA_WW_refresh_2868 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_clear_2868 = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_building_2868
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_2868
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2868 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_2868 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_2868 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_2868 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_2868 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_2868 value = 0 }
}
DA_WW_finish_2868 = {
	if = {
		limit = { 2868 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Exoskeletons_Workshop tier = 2 } } }
		2868 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Exoskeletons_Workshop tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Haraz_Orldhum_event.5 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Haraz_Orldhum_event.24 days = 3650 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.21 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 2868 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Exoskeletons_Workshop tier = 1 } } }
		2868 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Exoskeletons_Workshop tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Haraz_Orldhum_event.4 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.21 }
	}
	else = {
		2868 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Exoskeletons_Workshop tier = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_can_implement_platinum_exoskeletons
		country_event = { id = DA_Haraz_Orldhum_event.2 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Haraz_Orldhum_event.21 days = 365 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Haraz_Orldhum_event.22 days = 1095 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.21 }
	}
	DA_WW_clear_2868 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_2868 = yes
}
DA_WW_tick_2868 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_2868 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owns = 2868 } }
			DA_WW_clear_2868 = yes    # the hold was lost, and the works with it
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_halted_2868 = yes } }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2868 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_2868 value = 1 } } }
				DA_WW_finish_2868 = yes
			}
			else = { DA_WW_progress_2868 = yes }
		}
		else = { DA_WW_progress_2868 = yes }
	}
}

# ---------------- Halanna's Wrath (Ovdal Kanzad, 4247) ----------------
DA_WW_refresh_4247 = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 4247 4247 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Earth_Shatterer tier = 0 } } }
		4247 = {
			if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Earth_Shatterer tier = 2 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4247 value = 7500 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4247 value = 120 } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Earth_Shatterer tier = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4247 value = 3750 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4247 value = 60 } }
			else = { set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4247 value = 1600 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4247 value = 24 } }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4247 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_cost who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4247 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_cost }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4247 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_time who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4247 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_time }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4247 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4247 which = DA_WW_cg_4247 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4247 which = DA_WW_cl_4247 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4247 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4247 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4247 which = DA_WW_cf_4247 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4247 value = 0.1 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4247 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4247 value = 1000 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4247 value = 10 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4247 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4247 which = DA_WW_tg_4247 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4247 which = DA_WW_tl_4247 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4247 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4247 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4247 which = DA_WW_tf_4247 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4247 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4247 value = 1000 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4247 value = 10 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4247 value = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4247 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4247 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4247 value = 372 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4247 value = 372 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4247 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4247 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4247 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4247 value = 100 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 which = DA_WW_months_4247 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4247 value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4247 value = 16 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4247 value = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4247 value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4247 value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4247 value = 1 } }
			owner = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4247 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4247 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4247 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4247 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4247 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4247 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4247 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4247 which = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}
