DA_WW_clear_4247 = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4247
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4247
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4247 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4247 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4247 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4247 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4247 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4247 value = 0 }
}
DA_WW_finish_4247 = {
	if = {
		limit = { 4247 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Earth_Shatterer tier = 2 } } }
		4247 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Earth_Shatterer tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.22 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 4247 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Earth_Shatterer tier = 1 } } }
		4247 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Earth_Shatterer tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.22 }
	}
	else = {
		4247 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Earth_Shatterer tier = 1 } }
		4247 = { province_event = { id = DA_Hold_Ovdal_Kanzad_event.21 } }
	}
	DA_WW_clear_4247 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4247 = yes
}
DA_WW_tick_4247 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4247 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owns = 4247 } }
			DA_WW_clear_4247 = yes    # the hold was lost, and the works with it
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_halted_4247 = yes } }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4247 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4247 value = 1 } } }
				DA_WW_finish_4247 = yes
			}
			else = { DA_WW_progress_4247 = yes }
		}
		else = { DA_WW_progress_4247 = yes }
	}
}

# ---------------- Frozen Forge (Krakdhûmvror, 4208) ----------------
DA_WW_refresh_4208 = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 4208 4208 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 0 } } }
		4208 = {
			if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 2 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4208 value = 7500 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4208 value = 120 } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4208 value = 3750 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4208 value = 60 } }
			else = { set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4208 value = 1600 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4208 value = 24 } }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4208 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_cost who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4208 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_cost }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4208 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_time who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4208 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_time }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4208 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4208 which = DA_WW_cg_4208 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4208 which = DA_WW_cl_4208 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4208 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_4208 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4208 which = DA_WW_cf_4208 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4208 value = 0.1 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4208 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4208 value = 1000 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4208 value = 10 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4208 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4208 which = DA_WW_tg_4208 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4208 which = DA_WW_tl_4208 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4208 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_4208 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4208 which = DA_WW_tf_4208 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4208 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4208 value = 1000 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4208 value = 10 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4208 value = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4208 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4208 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4208 value = 372 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4208 value = 372 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4208 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4208 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4208 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4208 value = 100 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 which = DA_WW_months_4208 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4208 value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4208 value = 16 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4208 value = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4208 value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4208 value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4208 value = 1 } }
			owner = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_4208 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_4208 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_4208 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_4208 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_4208 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_4208 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_4208 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_4208 which = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}
DA_WW_progress_4208 = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4208 which = DA_WW_total_4208 }
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4208 which = DA_WW_left_4208 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4208 value = 100 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4208 value = 1 } } divide_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4208 which = DA_WW_total_4208 } }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4208 value = trigger_value:is_year }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 value = trigger_value:is_month }
	change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 which = DA_WW_left_4208 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4208 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4208 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4208 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4208 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_4208 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_4208 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4208 which = DA_WW_left_4208 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4208 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4208 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4208 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4208 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4208 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4208 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4208 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4208 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4208 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4208 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4208 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4208 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4208 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4208 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_4208 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_4208 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4208 which = DA_WW_paid_4208 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4208 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4208 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4208 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4208 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4208 value = 10 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4208 which = DA_WW_paid_4208 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4208 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4208 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4208 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4208 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4208 value = 10 }
}
DA_WW_begin_4208 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_begin_4208_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4208 which = DA_WW_cost_4208 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_cost_4208 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4208 which = DA_WW_months_4208 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4208 which = DA_WW_months_4208 }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4208
		clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4208
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_any_works
		DA_WW_progress_4208 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_rush_now_4208 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_rush_now_4208_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_rush_4208 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4208 value = 0.75 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4208 value = 0.001 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4208 value = 1000 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4208 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4208 value = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4208
		DA_WW_progress_4208 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_cancel_now_4208 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_cancel_now_4208_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_refund_4208 }
		DA_WW_give_t = yes
		if = { limit = { 4208 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 2 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 20 } }
		else_if = { limit = { 4208 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } }
		else = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 5 } }
		DA_WW_clear_4208 = yes
		DA_WW_refresh_4208 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_clear_4208 = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4208
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_4208
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4208 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_4208 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_4208 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_4208 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_4208 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_4208 value = 0 }
}
DA_WW_finish_4208 = {
	if = {
		limit = { 4208 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 2 } } }
		4208 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Krakdhumvror_event.14 days = 3650 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.24 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 4208 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 } } }
		4208 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Krakdhumvror_event.3 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.24 }
	}
	else = {
		4208 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Frozen_Forge tier = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_Krakdhumvror_event.2 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Krakdhumvror_event.11 days = 365 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Krakdhumvror_event.12 days = 1095 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.24 }
	}
	DA_WW_clear_4208 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4208 = yes
}
DA_WW_tick_4208 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4208 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owns = 4208 } }
			DA_WW_clear_4208 = yes    # the hold was lost, and the works with it
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_halted_4208 = yes } }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4208 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_4208 value = 1 } } }
				DA_WW_finish_4208 = yes
			}
			else = { DA_WW_progress_4208 = yes }
		}
		else = { DA_WW_progress_4208 = yes }
	}
}

# ---------------- Drowned Arsenal (Ovdal Tûngr, 526) ----------------
DA_WW_refresh_526 = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = 526 526 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 0 } } }
		526 = {
			if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 2 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_526 value = 7500 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_526 value = 120 } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_526 value = 3750 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_526 value = 60 } }
			else = { set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_526 value = 1600 } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_526 value = 24 } }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_526 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_cost who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_526 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_cost }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_526 value = modifier:great_project_upgrade_time who = owner }
			export_to_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_526 value = modifier:local_great_project_upgrade_time }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_526 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_526 which = DA_WW_cg_526 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_526 which = DA_WW_cl_526 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_526 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cf_526 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_526 which = DA_WW_cf_526 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_526 value = 0.1 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_526 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_526 value = 1000 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_526 value = 10 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_526 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_526 which = DA_WW_tg_526 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_526 which = DA_WW_tl_526 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_526 value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tf_526 value = 0.1 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_526 which = DA_WW_tf_526 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_526 value = 0.001 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_526 value = 1000 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_526 value = 10 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_526 value = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_526 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_526 value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_526 value = 372 } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_526 value = 372 } }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_526 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_526 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_526 value = 100 }
			multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_526 value = 100 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 which = DA_WW_months_526 }
			set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_526 value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_526 value = 16 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_526 value = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_526 value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_526 value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_526 value = 1 } }
			owner = {
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cost_526 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_months_526 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cg_526 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_cl_526 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tg_526 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tl_526 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dy_526 which = PREV }
				set_variable = { which = DA_WW_dm_526 which = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}
DA_WW_progress_526 = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_526 which = DA_WW_total_526 }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_526 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_526 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_526 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_526 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_526 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_526 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_526 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_fm_526 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_fy_526 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_526 which = DA_WW_left_526 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_526 value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_526 value = 192 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_526 value = 192 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_526 value = 16 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_526 value = 96 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_526 value = 96 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_526 value = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_526 value = 48 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_526 value = 48 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_526 value = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_526 value = 24 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_526 value = 24 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_526 value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_526 value = 12 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_lm_526 value = 12 } change_variable = { which = DA_WW_ly_526 value = 1 } }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_526 which = DA_WW_paid_526 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_526 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_526 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_526 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_526 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_526 value = 10 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_526 which = DA_WW_paid_526 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_526 value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_526 value = 0.1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_526 value = 0.001 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_526 value = 1000 }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_526 value = 10 }
}
DA_WW_begin_526 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_begin_526_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_526 which = DA_WW_cost_526 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_cost_526 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_526 which = DA_WW_months_526 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_526 which = DA_WW_months_526 }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_building_526
		clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_526
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_any_works
		DA_WW_progress_526 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_rush_now_526 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_rush_now_526_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_rush_526 }
		DA_WW_take_t = yes
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_526 value = 0.75 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_526 value = 0.001 }
		multiply_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_526 value = 1000 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_526 value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_526 value = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_526
		DA_WW_progress_526 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_cancel_now_526 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_WW_cancel_now_526_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_t which = DA_WW_refund_526 }
		DA_WW_give_t = yes
		if = { limit = { 526 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 2 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 20 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 20 } }
		else_if = { limit = { 526 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 1 } } } change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 10 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 10 } }
		else = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 5 } change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 5 } }
		DA_WW_clear_526 = yes
		DA_WW_refresh_526 = yes
	}
}
DA_WW_clear_526 = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_building_526
	clr_country_flag = DA_WW_rushed_526
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_526 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_total_526 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_paid_526 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_pct_526 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_rush_526 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_WW_refund_526 value = 0 }
}
DA_WW_finish_526 = {
	if = {
		limit = { 526 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 2 } } }
		526 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 1 } }
		DA_OT_sync = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_Ovdal_Tungr_event.14 days = 3650 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.25 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 526 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 1 } } }
		526 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 1 } }
		DA_OT_sync = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_Ovdal_Tungr_event.3 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Ovdal_Tungr_event.13 days = 365 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.25 }
	}
	else = {
		526 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal tier = 1 } }
		DA_enable_Metal_Ship = yes
		DA_OT_sync = yes
		country_event = { id = DA_Ovdal_Tungr_event.2 days = 30 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Ovdal_Tungr_event.11 days = 365 }
		country_event = { id = DA_Ovdal_Tungr_event.12 days = 1095 }
		country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.25 }
	}
	DA_WW_clear_526 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_526 = yes
}
DA_WW_tick_526 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_526 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { owns = 526 } }
			DA_WW_clear_526 = yes    # the hold was lost, and the works with it
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_halted_526 = yes } }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_526 value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_left_526 value = 1 } } }
				DA_WW_finish_526 = yes
			}
			else = { DA_WW_progress_526 = yes }
		}
		else = { DA_WW_progress_526 = yes }
	}
}

# ---------------- all wonders ----------------

DA_WW_refresh_all = {
	DA_WW_refresh_4039 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4217 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4284 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4119 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4236 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4020 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_2963 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_2931 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_2868 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4247 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_4208 = yes
	DA_WW_refresh_526 = yes
}

# on_monthly_pulse, for a country with works under way
DA_WW_monthly = {
	DA_WW_tick_4039 = yes
	DA_WW_tick_4217 = yes
	DA_WW_tick_4284 = yes
	DA_WW_tick_4119 = yes
	DA_WW_tick_4236 = yes
	DA_WW_tick_4020 = yes
	DA_WW_tick_2963 = yes
	DA_WW_tick_2931 = yes
	DA_WW_tick_2868 = yes
	DA_WW_tick_4247 = yes
	DA_WW_tick_4208 = yes
	DA_WW_tick_526 = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_WW_any_building = yes } }
		clr_country_flag = DA_WW_any_works
	}
}
